recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the FHIR-25257 prohibition on unconnected message Bundle content while aligning the older application sentence with later FHIR-I decisions and current graph-connected Bundle guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-25257 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for messaging and MessageHeader asking that all resources in a message Bundle be connected, directly or indirectly, to the MessageHeader so unconnected content cannot appear without computable meaning.
initial_application: Git commit 0b7a4055d444b1f400b9d3ddcca79a027c85909e initially applied the issue by adding a Basic Messaging Assumptions sentence that limited message Bundles to the MessageHeader and resources directly or indirectly referenced from it.
additional_context: Related same-family and later decisions changed how this rule is expressed. FHIR-23722 added the main message Bundle rule using traversal paths either to or from the MessageHeader, and FHIR-43295 later clarified document and message must-link requirements as connected graphs of RESTful references. Current Bundle guidance also describes messages and documents as a single interconnected graph and notes that some references may be reverse references.
reconciliation: Updated source/messaging.html so the Basic Messaging Assumptions sentence no longer uses forward-only 'referenced from it' wording and instead requires resources to be part of the connected graph of RESTful references that includes the MessageHeader.
source_changes: source/messaging.html: changed the Basic Messaging Assumptions sentence to require the connected graph of RESTful references that includes the MessageHeader instead of resources referenced from the MessageHeader.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue that added the main message Bundle content rule and allowed traversal paths either to or from the MessageHeader.
